findings.title: Bare dict annotation on _SORT_COLUMN_MAP
findings.problem: code-quality.md (Types And Imports) says to avoid bare dict annotations and prefer parameterized generics; the new _SORT_COLUMN_MAP class attribute is annotated with a bare dict.
findings.impact: The project's documented code-quality standard is blocking for the review gate and no automated lint rule enforces it, so new code lands in violation.

findings.title: trim() misses non-space whitespace names
findings.problem: The name sort key is lower(coalesce(nullif(trim(name), ''), username)). Postgres trim() with no characters argument removes only spaces, so a name consisting of tabs, newlines or non-breaking spaces is not treated as empty and does not fall back to username, contrary to the requirement and the code comment (NULL, empty or whitespace-only).
findings.impact: Users whose name is non-space whitespace sort by a blank-looking key (typically at the start of an asc page) instead of by username, so the Users list appears out of order. Reachability unconfirmed: whether IDP-provisioned names can contain such characters was not established.
findings.recommendation: Strip all whitespace before the empty check, e.g. `func.nullif(func.regexp_replace(UserDB.name, r'^\s+|\s+$', '', 'g'), '')` (Postgres), or narrow the comment/requirement to space-only; update NAME_EXPR in the sort test and add a case for a tab/newline-only name.
